correctness.rationale: Reconstructed inclusion-exclusion 15! S(x,15), odd-even split and the independent modular base certificate M_10=sum_{j odd}C(15,j)(j^{2^10}-1)=2^22 mod 2^23. The recurrence d_{n+1}=2d_n+d_n² forces nu2(M_n)=n+12 (n>=10); high-order binomial remainder ensures odd difference nu2= n+12+nu2(a-b). The even j=2,6,10,14 group has coefficient sum 8128=64*127 mod128, giving nu2(E)=b*2^n+6. Dividing by 15! valuation11 yields distinct-scale minimum and +1 resonance cancellation. Independently verified 21 non-resonant modular examples at n=10,11,12; no finite sample substituted for the induction and LTE.
